stem: Which of these describes the number 35,824?

options.label: F
options.text: The sum of three thousands, five thousands, eight hundreds, two tens, and four ones

options.label: G
options.text: The sum of thirty-five hundreds, eight tens, and twenty-four ones

options.label: H
options.text: The sum of three ten thousands, five thousands, eight hundreds, two tens, and four ones

options.label: J
options.text: The sum of five ten thousands, three thousands, eight hundreds, two tens, and four ones

visual_elements: Four answer choices labeled F, G, H, J with text as above
difficulty_rationale: Requires understanding place value and addition of the place values to correctly describe the number 35,824. Some answer choices mix place values, so it is more than simple recall.
